topic: Why your website has to work on a cheap phone and a slow connection
objective: Educate on a locally relevant issue
hook: Most of your customers will see your website on a phone, on data, on a weak signal.
cta: Open your website on your phone right now. How long did it take?
visualBrief: Side-by-side load comparison. Mention data cost, not just speed — that's what customers feel.
